mines.mine_notes: 80%-owned large-scale open-pit gold development project in south-east Côte d'Ivoire (~120km east of Abidjan, near the Ghanaian border), on a 227 km² granted mining permit (mining convention) within >1,600 km² total tenure. Pre-Feasibility Study completed 17 June 2026: nominal 6.0 Mtpa processing (4 Mtpa CIL + 2 Mtpa flotation/ultrafine grind/CIL), average LOM production ~200,000 ozpa over 10.3-year mine life (230,000 oz first year incl. 6-month ramp-up; ~215,000 ozpa avg first 7 years). LOM: 65.1 Mt processed @ 1.1 g/t = 2.3 Moz contained, strip ratio 4.8:1, 87-88% recovery, 2.0 Moz recovered. PFS economics (100% basis, conservative US$2,000/oz gold for reserve/schedule): development capital US$410M (incl. US$24M contingency, mining contractor establishment, US$32M RoM stockpile); sustaining capital US$101M LOM; LOM cash operating cost US$1,268/oz, AISC US$1,508/oz (incl. royalties, community contributions, sustaining capex). At US$3,000/3,500/4,000 per oz: post-tax NPV(5%) US$1,486M/US$2,102M/US$2,717M; post-tax IRR 60%/79%/97% pa; post-tax payback 17/13/10 months. Maiden JORC Probable Ore Reserve 55.1 Mt @ 1.1 g/t Au = 1.912 Moz (Woulo Woulo, Jonction, Anuiri, Asupiri). Production target based on Probable Reserves and Indicated Resources; contract-mining strategy. Royalties to the State of Côte d'Ivoire vary with gold price (6% above US$2,000/oz). DFS commenced immediately after the PFS; ESIA submission targeted 2H CY2026. No production; AISC/cash costs are PFS projections, not actuals.
mines.processing: Planned 6 Mtpa (4 Mtpa CIL + 2 Mtpa flotation/ultrafine grind/CIL)

notes: FY2025 annual report (year ended 31 December 2025, dated 31 March 2026). Formerly Manas Resources Limited, renamed Turaco Gold Limited in July 2021. FY2025: cash and cash equivalents A$68.08M at 31 Dec 2025 (2024: A$32.88M); total comprehensive loss A$26.70M; $64M capital raise at 44c completed June 2025. June 2025: interest in the Afema Project increased to 80% (~36.3M shares issued to the minority JV partner as final consideration); final deferred cash consideration of US$650,000 paid to Endeavour Mining plc for the initial 51% interest in the mining permit. AR MRE as at 31 Dec 2025: Indicated 55.5 Mt @ 1.2 g/t = 2.16 Moz; Inferred 47.4 Mt @ 1.2 g/t = 1.9 Moz; Total 102.9 Mt @ 1.2 g/t = 4.06 Moz. Post-AR updates: March 2026 MRE 115.3 Mt @ 1.3 g/t = 4.65 Moz (18 Mar 2026); June 2026 PFS with maiden Probable Ore Reserve 1.912 Moz; DFS underway; Jessica Volich and Brett Gossage appointed non-executive directors 31 July 2026. Managing Director Justin Tremain. Dual OTC listing: TCGDF. All dollar figures as stated in the report (project economics in USD).

reserves_resources.notes: MRE 67.1 Mt @ 1.2 g/t Au (announced 18 March 2026; post-dates the FY2025 AR).

MRE total 115.3 Mt @ 1.3 g/t Au = 4.65 Moz across seven deposits: Woulo Woulo 53.5 Mt @ 1.0 = 1,700 koz; Herman 2.0 Mt @ 1.6 = 100 koz; Jonction 9.8 Mt @ 2.1 = 650 koz; Anuiri 10.2 Mt @ 1.8 = 570 koz; Asupiri 33.8 Mt @ 1.2 = 1,320 koz; Begnopan 5.1 Mt @ 1.5 = 260 koz; Toilesso 1.0 Mt @ 1.4 = 40 koz. Open-pit constrained at US$3,250/oz, 0.5 g/t cut-off (Jonction underground 1.5 g/t cut-off). AR MRE as at 31 Dec 2025 was 102.9 Mt @ 1.2 g/t = 4.06 Moz.

Maiden JORC Probable Ore Reserve 55.1 Mt @ 1.1 g/t Au = 1,912 koz (no Proven; no Measured Resources): Woulo Woulo 35.6 Mt @ 0.8 = 962 koz; Jonction 1.9 Mt @ 2.1 = 128 koz; Anuiri 5.0 Mt @ 1.9 = 309 koz; Asupiri 12.5 Mt @ 1.3 = 513 koz. Based on Indicated Resources, US$2,000/oz gold price, incl. mining recovery and dilution; reported 17 June 2026.
Ore Reserve total 55.1 Mt @ 1.1 g/t Au = 1.912 Moz (all Probable, JORC 2012, open pit). Begnopan included in the LOM schedule but not in the Reserve pending infill drilling.
